text:
leo_sales: Prospect asks if we can run a timeboxed POC fully inside an edge island (aws wl zone) with BYO-KMS and a carrier-only subproc attestation. Need a quick 'yes/no + caveats' to move the deal.
infra_amy: Short: compute yes (Dedicated/Private), control plane no (needs proxy). Caveats: kernel/instance SKU checks, ENI/peering required, and some agent telemetry may need to be disabled.
sre_jordi: Ops notes: we'll disable prefix caching and token-level logs for the POC to avoid egress. If they insist on zero control-plane egress we need a lightweight proxy in their VPC that mirrors auth endpoints. That adds ~3-5 days.
legal_kim: We can provide our subprocessor manifest. Carrier attestation must come from the telco. If they want contractual restriction to carrier-only subprocs, that's an exception and needs a one-off DPA appendix.
leo_sales: Carrier is "NorthBridge Mobile LLC" per RFP. Customer accepts POC risk if wl zone saturated but prefers rejection over fallback. Can we share an ops snippet that shows strict zone preference + no-fallback and BYO-KMS hint?
sre_jordi: Share this minimal policy + operational caveats in the email. Include: preferred_zone=us-east-1-wl2, fallback=[], byo_kms=true, telemetry=minimal, kv_cache=off. Call out: "no fallback = request rejection if capacity exhausted."
deploy-bot: Ticket PR-9801 opened for wl2 validation and proxy feasibility (ETA 72h).
leo_sales: Thanks folks — I'll bundle the snippet, DPA note, and telco attestation ask and send to the customer today.
